headline: Stlican Shelf and Nevish Line Shift Under Heavy Shellfire
war_summary: Violent clashes persisted along the northern and eastern sectors over the past three hours, led by fresh tactical shifts in Nevish Line and Stlican Shelf. Nevish Line recorded continued turmoil with another strategic transfer following sustained combat across Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother, while Stlican Shelf flared anew as Breaker Town saw a recent base flip amid mounting casualties. Heavy attrition raged unabated in Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse, where the two meatgrinders combined for over fifty-four hundred casualties across the last two hours despite no immediate boundary shifts. In Linn of Mercy, base exchanges quieted following earlier turmoil at Outwich Ranch and Lathair, though localized skirmishing remains substantial. Combat in Fisherman's Row and Dead Lands slowed sharply after earlier surges, while Palantine Berm and Marban Hollow sustained steady, grinding engagements across contested ground.
